'''Delriss''' was a rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Thousands of years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the planet was mined for rare ores, though they eventually were exhausted. It was orbited by the [[aquatic moon of Delriss]].<ref name="CotG" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]'' {{1st}}
